verdict.rationale: A government tax and customs portal could plausibly offer a test environment for its machine channel (e.g., invoice or declaration webservices), so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only citizen-facing portal navigation and service-availability notices, with no mention of a sandbox, test endpoint or developer test environment. The llms.txt probe returned a 404, showing no agent-oriented docs index is published, but that says nothing either way about a sandbox.
